types.summary: Contract event filters

fields.name: contractId
fields.description:
One contract id, or a SET of them (max 20) — the standard DeFi shape is
a router plus N pools, which used to cost N near-identical sources and
handlers. Payload types are identical per `type`, so one handler serves
the set and `event.contractId` disambiguates.

Supports `*` wildcards (e.g. `"SP1ABC….pool-*"`). Mutually exclusive
with `trait`, which resolves its own set per block.

fields.name: abi
fields.description:
Contract ABI (pass it `as const`) used to type `event.input` — the named,
decoded function arguments. Dev-provided; serialized into the deployed
definition and used at runtime to decode args by name. Omit to keep
`event.args` as a positional `unknown[]`.

Required whenever `functionName` is set. `secondlayer subgraphs deploy`
fills it in from the deployed contract for a single concrete
`contractId`; pass it yourself for wildcard, multi-contract or trait
sources, or a local deploy (`normalizeAbi()` from
`@secondlayer/stacks/clarity`).

fields.name: client
fields.description:
Read-only contract calls pinned to this block. Erased here for the same
reason as on `SubgraphContext`: an ABI-generic method on a structurally
compared interface exceeds TS's instantiation budget. Wrap it with
`readContractAt(ctx, id, abi)` for full ABI typing at the call site.

fields.name: insert
fields.description:
Queues a new row for a table.

Writes are batched and applied together when the block commits.
`_block_height` and `_tx_id` are filled in for you.

fields.name: update
fields.type: (table: T, where: RowWhere<S, T>, set: Partial<{ [K in keyof T["columns"] as IsOptionalColumn<T["columns"][K]> extends true ? never : K]: WriteColumnType<T["columns"][K]>; } & { [K in keyof T["columns"] as IsOptionalColumn<T["columns"][K]> extends true ? K : never]?: WriteColumnType<T["columns"][K]>; }>) => void
fields.description:
Queues an update to the rows matching `where`.

`set` holds only the columns to change.

fields.name: upsert
fields.type: (table: T, key: K, row: Omit<{ [K in keyof T["columns"] as IsOptionalColumn<T["columns"][K]> extends true ? never : K]: WriteColumnType<T["columns"][K]>; } & { [K in keyof T["columns"] as IsOptionalColumn<T["columns"][K]> extends true ? K : never]?: WriteColumnType<T["columns"][K]>; }, keyof K> & Partial<{ [K in keyof T["columns"] as IsOptionalColumn<T["columns"][K]> extends true ? never : K]: WriteColumnType<T["columns"][K]>; } & { [K in keyof T["columns"] as IsOptionalColumn<T["columns"][K]> extends true ? K : never]?: WriteColumnType<T["columns"][K]>; }>) => void
fields.description:
Inserts a row, or updates the one with the same key.

`key` should match a `uniqueKeys` constraint of the table. Without one the
write falls back to a lookup first and logs a warning.

fields.name: delete
fields.description: Queues deletion of the rows matching `where`.

fields.name: increment
fields.type: (table: T, key: Partial<{ [K in keyof T["columns"] as IsOptionalColumn<T["columns"][K]> extends true ? never : K]: WriteColumnType<T["columns"][K]>; } & { [K in keyof T["columns"] as IsOptionalColumn<T["columns"][K]> extends true ? K : never]?: WriteColumnType<T["columns"][K]>; }>, deltas: Record<string, Record<ColumnName<S, T>, number | bigint>[string] | undefined>) => void
fields.description:
Adds signed deltas to a counter row, creating it if missing.

It compiles to `INSERT … ON CONFLICT (key) DO UPDATE SET col =
COALESCE(col,0) + delta`. Deltas commute, so it is the reorg-safe way to
keep running totals such as per-cycle aggregates and balances. It needs a
`uniqueKeys` constraint matching `key`, and deltas may be `number` or
`bigint`.

fields.name: findOne
fields.type: (table: T, where: RowWhere<S, T>) => Promise<SystemRow & { [K in keyof T["columns"]]: InferColumnType<T["columns"][K]>; } | null>
fields.description:
Returns the first row matching `where`, or `null`.

Reads see the writes queued earlier in the same block, and rows come back
in insertion order.

fields.name: findMany
fields.type: (table: T, where: RowWhere<S, T>) => Promise<SystemRow & { [K in keyof T["columns"]]: InferColumnType<T["columns"][K]>; }[]>
fields.description:
Returns every row matching `where`, in insertion order.

Reads see the writes queued earlier in the same block.
